purpose: Prioritize interview probability for fully remote or approved hybrid work without overstating direct industry experience.

primary_market_identity.headline: Former Detective & Digital Forensic Examiner | Public-Safety Software Training, Technical Support & Evidence Workflows
primary_market_identity.positioning: Former detective and digital-forensic examiner who helps public-safety organizations adopt technology, resolve evidence and workflow problems, train users, and communicate clearly under pressure.
primary_market_identity.retention_context: Intentionally pursuing a hands-on individual-contributor role.

primary: Product Specialist - Public Safety or Digital Evidence
reach_or_deprioritized: SIU Investigator II or III requiring direct carrier claims experience
Senior Customer Success Manager owning renewals or expansion
Senior Implementation Consultant requiring full-cycle SaaS deployments
Solutions Architect or Sales Engineer requiring quota or presales ownership
Enterprise DFIR requiring current SIEM, EDR, cloud incident response, or reverse engineering
Loss Prevention or Asset Protection roles tied to stores, sites, or field territories

probability_gate.principle: Mandatory direct-experience requirements override transferable fit and keyword similarity.
material_gaps_that_prevent_tier_1: Required years owning full-cycle SaaS implementations
Required ownership of renewals, ARR, NRR, expansion, or a book of business
Required direct insurance claims-file ownership, EUOs, claims law, or carrier SIU tenure
Required active adjuster or other occupational license not already verified
Required production application-support, networking, cloud, SIEM, EDR, coding, reverse-engineering, or incident-response experience not already verified
Required sales quota, pipeline, or formal presales ownership
Required people-management scope not already verified

classifications.direct: Verified function and relevant industry line; no material mandatory gap.
classifications.core: Verified function; industry line is compatible or unspecified; no material mandatory gap.
classifications.transferable: Credible evidence bridge exists, but industry, platform, or operating model differs.
classifications.reach: One or more material mandatory gaps remain; do not score or label as Tier 1.
classifications.reject: Hard requirement is unsupported and not realistically bridgeable for this search.

tier_rules.tier_1: Direct or Core, score at least 78, no material mandatory gap, location/travel/pay acceptable.
tier_rules.tier_2: Transferable, score at least 70, no hard disqualifier, explicit bridge and hiring concern recorded.
tier_rules.tier_3: Human review only; lower probability or compensation/travel compromise.
tier_rules.reach: Never relabel as Tier 1 solely because transferable skills or keywords produce a high score.

application_operating_limits.freshness: Prefer applications within 48 hours of posting.
application_operating_limits.required_human_connection: For each serious application, identify one defensible recruiter, hiring manager, team member, or former law-enforcement employee; draft outreach but do not send without approval.
application_operating_limits.follow_up: One follow-up after 5-7 business days when appropriate, then continue the search.
application_operating_limits.incomplete_rule: A packet in Drafting does not count as a completed application.

source_and_privacy_rules.medical_retirement_in_private_sector_mar: omit unless Troy explicitly requests it
